an8.148-627:1.27: niṭṭhitaṁ → rāgapadato paṭṭhāya pamādapadapariyantesu sattarassu padesu ekamekaṁ abhiññāyādi dasapadehi yojetvā ‘aṭṭha dhammā bhāvetabbā’ti niddiṭṭhehi tīhi aṭṭhamaggaṅga-aṭṭha abhibhāyatana- aṭṭhavimokkha suttehi paccekaṁ ghaṭitāni sabbasuttāni dasādhika pañcasatāni honti (bj note)
